## Load Data

```{r load_data_packages}
library(tidyverse)

load("clean_data/data_imputed.RData")

# Filter to only RV and nRV cohorts
table_data <- data_imp %>%
  filter(cohort %in% c("RV", "nRV"))

```

```{r helper_functions, echo=FALSE}
# Format mean (SD)
mean_sd <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) return("--")
  sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))
}

# Format n (%)
n_pct <- function(x, condition = 1) {
  n <- sum(x == condition, na.rm = TRUE)
  total <- sum(!is.na(x))
  if (total == 0) return("--")
  sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, n / total * 100)
}

# Format count
n_count <- function(x) {
  sum(!is.na(x))
}

# Format p-value
format_pval <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("--")
  if (p < 0.001) return("<0.001")
  sprintf("%.3f", p)
}

# Compare continuous variables (t-test or Wilcoxon based on normality)
compare_continuous <- function(x1, x2) {
  x1 <- x1[!is.na(x1)]
  x2 <- x2[!is.na(x2)]
  if (length(x1) < 3 || length(x2) < 3) return(NA)

  # Check normality with Shapiro-Wilk (use smaller sample if n > 5000)
  norm1 <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(head(x1, 5000))$p.value, error = function(e) 0)
  norm2 <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(head(x2, 5000))$p.value, error = function(e) 0)

  if (norm1 > 0.05 && norm2 > 0.05) {
    # Both normal: use t-test
    tryCatch(t.test(x1, x2)$p.value, error = function(e) NA)
  } else {
    # Non-normal: use Wilcoxon rank-sum
    tryCatch(wilcox.test(x1, x2)$p.value, error = function(e) NA)
  }
}

# Compare categorical variables (Fisher's exact test for all comparisons)
compare_categorical <- function(var, group) {
  tbl <- table(var, group, useNA = "no")
  if (nrow(tbl) < 2 || ncol(tbl) < 2) return(NA)
  tryCatch(fisher.test(tbl)$p.value, error = function(e) NA)
}

# Compare binary variables (Fisher's exact test for all comparisons)
compare_binary <- function(x, group) {
  tbl <- table(x, group, useNA = "no")
  if (nrow(tbl) < 2 || ncol(tbl) < 2) return(NA)
  tryCatch(fisher.test(tbl)$p.value, error = function(e) NA)
}
```

## Calculate Statistics by ECMO Status

```{r calculate_stats}
# Split data by ECMO status
cannulated <- table_data %>% filter(ecmo_yn == 1)
not_cannulated <- table_data %>% filter(ecmo_yn == 0)

```

## Table 1

```{r table1}
# Build table data frame
table1 <- data.frame(
  Variable = c(
    "Total Number",
    "Age, mean (SD)",
    "Sex, % male",
    "Race, % White",
    "Race, % African American",
    "9-1-1 call to hospital arrival time (min), mean (SD)",
    "HEMS launch time (min), mean (SD)",
    "HEMS scene time (min), mean (SD)",
    "HEMS flight time (min), mean (SD)",
    "Needle stick to ECMO time (min), mean (SD)",
    "VT/VF, n (%)",
    "Witnessed cardiac arrest, n (%)",
    "Bystander CPR, n (%)",
    "LUCAS placed, n (%)",
    "Field intubation, n (%)",
    "Number of shocks, mean (SD)",
    "Lactate, mean (SD)",

    "Low flow time (min), mean (SD)",
    "Days on V-A ECMO, mean (SD)",
    "Hospital LOS (days), mean (SD)",
    "Alive at discharge, n (%)"
  ),

  All_Patients = c(
    nrow(table_data),

    n_pct(table_data$bystander_cpr, 1),
    n_pct(table_data$lucas, 1),
    n_pct(table_data$field_intubation, 1),
    mean_sd(table_data$n_shocks),
    mean_sd(table_data$lactate),
    mean_sd(table_data$ph),
    mean_sd(table_data$low_flow_time),
    mean_sd(table_data$ecmo_days),
    mean_sd(table_data$los_days),
    n_pct(table_data$alive, 1)
  ),

  Cannulated = c(
    nrow(cannulated),
    mean_sd(cannulated$age),
    n_pct(cannulated$sex, 1),
    n_pct(cannulated$race, 1),
    n_pct(cannulated$race, 2),
    mean_sd(cannulated$call_to_cann_hosp_time),
    mean_sd(cannulated$hems_launch_time),
    mean_sd(cannulated$hems_scene_time),
    mean_sd(cannulated$hems_flight_time),
    mean_sd(cannulated$ecmo_time),
    n_pct(cannulated$init_rhythm, "VT/VF"),
    n_pct(cannulated$witnessed, 1),
    n_pct(cannulated$bystander_cpr, 1),
    n_pct(cannulated$lucas, 1),
    n_pct(cannulated$field_intubation, 1),
    mean_sd(cannulated$n_shocks),
    mean_sd(cannulated$lactate),
    mean_sd(cannulated$ph),
    mean_sd(cannulated$low_flow_time),
    mean_sd(cannulated$ecmo_days),
    mean_sd(cannulated$los_days),
    n_pct(cannulated$alive, 1)
  ),

  Not_Cannulated = c(
    nrow(not_cannulated),
    mean_sd(not_cannulated$age),
    n_pct(not_cannulated$sex, 1),
    n_pct(not_cannulated$race, 1),
    n_pct(not_cannulated$race, 2),
    mean_sd(not_cannulated$call_to_cann_hosp_time),
    mean_sd(not_cannulated$hems_launch_time),
    mean_sd(not_cannulated$hems_scene_time),
    mean_sd(not_cannulated$hems_flight_time),
    "N/A",
    n_pct(not_cannulated$init_rhythm, "VT/VF"),
    n_pct(not_cannulated$witnessed, 1),
    n_pct(not_cannulated$bystander_cpr, 1),
    n_pct(not_cannulated$lucas, 1),
    n_pct(not_cannulated$field_intubation, 1),
    mean_sd(not_cannulated$n_shocks),
    mean_sd(not_cannulated$lactate),
    mean_sd(not_cannulated$ph),
    mean_sd(not_cannulated$low_flow_time),
    "N/A",
    mean_sd(not_cannulated$los_days),
    n_pct(not_cannulated$alive, 1)

  P_Value = c(
    "--",
    format_pval(compare_continuous(cannulated$age, not_cannulated$age)),
    format_pval(compare_binary(table_data$sex, table_data$ecmo_yn)),
    format_pval(compare_binary(table_data$race == 1, table_data$ecmo_yn)),
    format_pval(compare_binary(table_data$race == 2, table_data$ecmo_yn)),
    format_pval(compare_continuous(cannulated$call_to_cann_hosp_time, not_cannulated$call_to_cann_hosp_time)),
    format_pval(compare_continuous(cannulated$hems_launch_time, not_cannulated$hems_launch_time)),
    format_pval(compare_continuous(cannulated$hems_scene_time, not_cannulated$hems_scene_time)),
    format_pval(compare_continuous(cannulated$hems_flight_time, not_cannulated$hems_flight_time)),
    "--",
    format_pval(compare_binary(table_data$init_rhythm == "VT/VF", table_data$ecmo_yn)),
    format_pval(compare_binary(table_data$witnessed, table_data$ecmo_yn)),
    format_pval(compare_binary(table_data$bystander_cpr, table_data$ecmo_yn)),
    format_pval(compare_binary(table_data$lucas, table_data$ecmo_yn)),
    format_pval(compare_binary(table_data$field_intubation, table_data$ecmo_yn)),
    format_pval(compare_continuous(cannulated$n_shocks, not_cannulated$n_shocks)),
    format_pval(compare_continuous(cannulated$lactate, not_cannulated$lactate)),
    "--",  # pH: insufficient sample size in not cannulated group
    format_pval(compare_continuous(cannulated$low_flow_time, not_cannulated$low_flow_time)),
    "--",
    format_pval(compare_continuous(cannulated$los_days, not_cannulated$los_days)),
    format_pval(compare_binary(table_data$alive, table_data$ecmo_yn))
  )
)

knitr::kable(table1, col.names = c("Variable", "All Patients", "Patients Cannulated for ECPR", "Patients Not Cannulated for ECPR", "P-Value"))
```

*Continuous variables compared using independent samples t-test (normally distributed) or Wilcoxon rank-sum test (non-normally distributed). Categorical variables compared using Fisher's exact test. Normality assessed via Shapiro-Wilk test.*

## Missingness Summary

```{r missingness, echo=FALSE}
# Show missingness for key variables
vars_of_interest <- c("age", "sex", "race", "call_to_cann_hosp_time", "hems_launch_time",
                      "hems_scene_time", "hems_flight_time", "ecmo_time", "init_rhythm",
                      "witnessed", "bystander_cpr", "lucas", "field_intubation", "n_shocks",
                      "lactate", "ph", "low_flow_time", "ecmo_days", "los_days", "alive")

missingness <- data.frame(
  Variable = vars_of_interest,
  Cannulated_Missing = sapply(vars_of_interest, function(v) {
    if (v %in% names(cannulated)) sum(is.na(cannulated[[v]])) else NA
  }),
  Cannulated_Total = nrow(cannulated),
  NotCannulated_Missing = sapply(vars_of_interest, function(v) {
    if (v %in% names(not_cannulated)) sum(is.na(not_cannulated[[v]])) else NA
  }),
  NotCannulated_Total = nrow(not_cannulated)
)

rownames(missingness) <- NULL
missingness <- missingness %>%
  mutate(
    Cannulated_Pct = round(Cannulated_Missing / Cannulated_Total * 100, 1),
    NotCannulated_Pct = round(NotCannulated_Missing / NotCannulated_Total * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  select(Variable, Cannulated_Missing, Cannulated_Pct, NotCannulated_Missing, NotCannulated_Pct)

library(kableExtra)
knitr::kable(missingness,
             col.names = c("Variable", "Missing (n)", "Missing (%)", "Missing (n)", "Missing (%)")) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Cannulated" = 2, "Not Cannulated" = 2))
```
